dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical geometric narrowing beginning posterior to the flipper insertion points and accelerating towards a sharp vertex at the peduncle terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity consistent across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal shadow-based variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of faint, low-contrast longitudinal linear marks are visible on the left side of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Highly defined, elevated central dorsal ridge; a slight transverse concavity is visible in the nuchal region behind the head.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, healed linear striations located on the left lateral mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely prominent and sharp structural dorsal ridge extending approximately half the visible body length.
